worst_moment: "The units matter because you can't multiply km/h by seconds directly. Let's convert 72 km/h to m/s first." - just restates the rule when the student asked why.
best_moment: "No, 72 km/h isn't 72 metres per second. Let's think: how many metres are in a kilometre, and how many seconds in an hour?" - breaks the conversion into facts the student knows and lets them reach 20 m/s.
